summary: Proposed rolling staging/checkout-api back from v1.4.2 to v1.4.1.

policy_reference.policy_description: Autonomous agents may propose remediations but may never apply a write or production-affecting change without a recorded human approval. Proposals must state the exact command or diff to be applied.

evidence.source: proposed manifest change for deployment staging/checkout-api

snapshot_ref_or_inline.content:
--- deployment/checkout-api.yaml (current, v1.4.2)
+++ deployment/checkout-api.yaml (proposed, v1.4.1)
@@ -18,7 +18,7 @@ spec:
     spec:
       containers:
       - name: checkout-api
-        image: registry.internal/checkout-api:v1.4.2
+        image: registry.internal/checkout-api:v1.4.1

proposed_action.description: Roll the checkout-api deployment back to image tag v1.4.1, the last release before the nullable shipping_cost change. This restores service while the null-handling bug in handler.py is fixed properly. It does not alter data: carts written under v1.4.2 keep their null shipping_cost and will be handled by v1.4.1's non-null default on next write.

outcome.details: Proposal recorded. No change applied; awaiting human approval.
